title: DHCP fails after snooping is enabled
scenario: ASW3 has one uplink, Gi0/2, to a distribution switch that relays client requests to DHCP. VLAN 10 clients cannot complete fresh leases after snooping is enabled. The upstream capture confirms a valid server reply reaches ASW3 Gi0/2. Option 82 insertion is disabled in this lab.

exhibits.title: ASW3 relevant configuration
exhibits.text:
ip dhcp snooping
ip dhcp snooping vlan 10
no ip dhcp snooping information option
!
interface GigabitEthernet0/2
 switchport mode trunk
 switchport trunk allowed vlan 10
!
interface FastEthernet0/1
 switchport mode access
 switchport access vlan 10

exhibits.title: Authored verification observations
exhibits.text:
Gi0/2: up, VLAN 10 forwarding
DHCP snooping: Gi0/2 untrusted
Valid DHCP Offer reaches Gi0/2; snooping records a server-message drop
Client binding table: empty

question: Which fault is established by the combined evidence?
options: The client-facing port lacks a sticky MAC entry
The DHCP pool must be using the wrong subnet mask
The legitimate reply arrives on an untrusted ingress
Option 82 insertion must be enabled on every client
explanation: The evidence locates a valid Offer at Gi0/2 and a snooping drop on that untrusted ingress. The necessary repair is server trust on this verified reply path. The exhibit does not establish a pool, port-security or Option 82 requirement.
fix:
```ios ASW3
ASW3# configure terminal
ASW3(config)# interface gigabitethernet0/2
ASW3(config-if)# ip dhcp snooping trust
ASW3(config-if)# end
ASW3# show ip dhcp snooping
```
Request a fresh client lease, inspect `show ip dhcp snooping binding`, and test the gateway. Keep client ports untrusted. Save only after the intended path and successful lease are verified.

title: A phone and PC exceed the permitted MAC total
scenario: Fa0/7 serves an approved phone and attached PC. Both lose network service when the PC starts transmitting. Inventory and a previous permitted capture establish that this particular phone/PC combination uses exactly two secure entries: the phone in voice VLAN 20 and the PC in data VLAN 10. No additional device is present.

exhibits.title: ASW1 port-security state (excerpt)
exhibits.text:
Port Status             : Secure-shutdown
Violation Mode          : Shutdown
Maximum MAC Addresses   : 1
Total MAC Addresses     : 1
Sticky MAC Addresses    : 1
Last Source Address:Vlan : 0050.56b1.9c22:10

exhibits.title: ASW1 Fa0/7 configuration
exhibits.text:
interface FastEthernet0/7
 switchport mode access
 switchport access vlan 10
 switchport voice vlan 20
 switchport port-security
 switchport port-security mac-address sticky
 switchport port-security mac-address sticky 0011.bb27.4e10 vlan voice

exhibits.title: Verified endpoint inventory
exhibits.text:
Phone: 0011.bb27.4e10, VLAN 20
PC:    0050.56b1.9c22, VLAN 10
No other secure entries required on this tested combination

question: What explains the repeated error-disable event?
options: The approved PC exceeds the one-entry total already occupied by the phone
The phone's tagged voice traffic requires all data traffic to be trunked
The configured shutdown response permits only voice traffic after the second source arrives.
The existing sticky entry is removed automatically when the data VLAN begins forwarding.
explanation: The one-entry maximum is already occupied by the phone. The approved PC becomes a second source and triggers shutdown mode. Correct the limit to the verified endpoint requirement before resetting the port; merely bouncing it would leave the cause intact.
fix:
```ios ASW1
ASW1# configure terminal
ASW1(config)# interface fastethernet0/7
ASW1(config-if)# switchport port-security maximum 2
ASW1(config-if)# shutdown
ASW1(config-if)# no shutdown
ASW1(config-if)# end
ASW1# show port-security interface fastethernet0/7
ASW1# show port-security address
```
Generate phone and PC traffic, verify the two intended address/VLAN entries and restored service, then save. A different phone model or VLAN behavior may need a different total; derive it from the actual design.
